## Summary

- refresh the Phase 0 stable-release aggregate source guard to current main after PR #650 (commit 3e7dec205f7d273a8499b75d7101e675444dafc4)
- retain PR #651 as open and outside merged current-main evidence
- add the after-650 blocked evidence bundle, including merged/closed/open PR snapshots, CI run snapshots, gate summaries, and SHA-256 checksums
- keep Phase 0 blocked: 13 required gates, 6 closed, 7 still blocking

## Verification

- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release tools.tests.test_phase0_module_ownership -v
- make phase0-module-ownership-gate PHASE0_MODULE_OWNERSHIP_SUMMARY=docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-07-after-650-current-main-gate-blocked/phase0-module-ownership-summary.json
- make phase0-stable-release-gate PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT=3e7dec205f7d273a8499b75d7101e675444dafc4 PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_SUMMARY=docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-07-after-650-current-main-gate-blocked/phase0-stable-release-summary.json
- make phase0-stable-release-gate PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT=3e7dec205f7d273a8499b75d7101e675444dafc4 PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_REQUIRE_PASS=1 PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_SUMMARY=docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-07-after-650-current-main-gate-blocked/phase0-stable-release-summary.json returns expected exit 2
- make evidence-tools-test
- shasum -a 256 -c docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-07-after-650-current-main-gate-blocked/SHA256SUMS
- git diff --check
title: docs: refresh phase0 aggregate after PR 650
